'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Chris Terwilliger DS Spice Mine Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Terwilliger]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet '''Chris Twigg''' / '''vader322'''; dest [[Chris Terwilliger]]. Objective listed mid-sheet; start [[Spice Mine Operations (V)]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Spice Mine Operations (V) (Virtual Block 6)|Spice Mine Operations (V)]]
* '''Username:''' vader322
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
